crossRefs.note: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
“ ‘If by these things you won’t be turned back to me, but will walk contrary to me,
If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious…
But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be…
Now I know that Yahweh is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”
With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
Woe to him who strives with his Maker— a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth! Shall the clay ask him who fashions…

parallels.note: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

translations.web: With the pure you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
translations.bsb: to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
translations.kjv: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.
translations.asv: With the pure thou wilt show thyself pure; And with the perverse thou wilt show thyself froward.
